headline: January and February will bring an increase: how the new minimum wage and indexation will change payments to Russians in 2027
summary: Large-scale indexation of Russian social payments in 2027 will take effect from 1 January and 1 February. The changes cover families, pensioners and beneficiaries.
why: Social payment indexation affects household consumption and government spending in the Russian economy.
